section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating Grant Agreement Annex templates as the governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts (partners, capabilities, roles, objectives, prior experience, budget, team size, equipment) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing any Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions to allow progress with incomplete inputs.
Finalizing proposal text when source state is incomplete/contradictory/unvalidated without flagging the gap.
Using generic Horizon Europe programme knowledge as a substitute for Tier 1 source documents.
Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific Tier 1–4 inputs.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.
